_comment: Sourcing currency conversion. Update `rate` when your exchange moves.
_rate: MVR per 1 unit of sourceCurrency, from your licensed exchange.
_fee: Applied on top of the converted amount: percent first, then flat.
_rounding: up | nearest | none — applied last, to the whole MVR amount.
_rates: Other currencies you browse in. The capture records which one the page showed, and the editor converts with the matching rate.
